notes: Pure public-API Annex C.6 Create Federation Execution witnesses use three schema-valid, adapter-owned FOM modules declaring one user-defined transportation type. The native-green preflight case exercises the same duplicate rule with MIM modules; this portable witness independently checks FOM-supplied declarations and passed installed-package CTest/direct 8/8 each across both callback models. Equal duplicates compose and the joined member resolves the standard transportation handle/name lookup. An added note reference rejects the pair as InconsistentFOM and a valid Create reuses the name. Java parity compiles against the API-only JAR, and both focused packaged Umbra JNI runtime scenarios passed (out/java-tck/transportation-duplicate-equal-jni-20261021.json and out/java-tck/transportation-duplicate-note-conflict-jni-20261021.json). Other Java providers, transport delivery, other element conflicts, interoperability, and conformance are not claimed.
